name: with_block_scope_smuggling
title: with-block opens scope chain over process making exit() a free identifier

payload.input: with (process) { exit(0) } executed in non-strict mode
payload.success_criteria: exit resolves on the with-scope and the process terminates

node.observable: non-strict with-block resolves exit on process and the process exits

bun.observable: non-strict with-block resolves exit on process and the process exits

frankenengine.observable: the with object must be obtained by a bare `process` read, which capability-typed lowering refuses for every profile (FE-CLAIM-006) before anything runs; with statements lower through a rewrite whose free references stay visible to the ambient-authority check, so the with scope adds no authority beyond member access on an object the program already holds (bd-9vouw.101)

measurement.failure_signal: lowering refuses the with-statement at compile time
